title: ROG Xbox Ally X Review Roundup: The Best PC Handheld?
description: Volt’s research-based verdict on the ROG Xbox Ally X: the performance and Xbox interface reviewers praise, and the price and battery catches to weigh.
h1: ROG Xbox Ally X: Volt’s verdict
intro: Xbox and ASUS teamed up for a handheld that hides Windows behind a console-style interface. Reviewers rate the Ally X highly, at a high price.
verdict: The most powerful, most console-like Windows handheld. Pricey, though.
pros: Fast AMD Z2 Extreme chip with 24GB of memory
Xbox full-screen interface makes Windows feel console-like
Plays Xbox PC, Game Pass, Steam and other stores
cons: Expensive, especially against a Steam Deck
Battery life in demanding games is short
Still Windows underneath, with occasional quirks
bestFor: Game Pass and PC gamers who want top handheld performance.
skipIf: You’re on a budget (consider the Steam Deck OLED or the standard Ally).
cardText: The most powerful console-like Windows handheld, at a price.

sections.html: Trusted Reviews called it the definitive Windows handheld at the time, praising performance and ergonomics. Notebookcheck scored it 85.9%, noting the Xbox interface improves usability. Battery life and price were the repeated caveats.
If performance is the priority and the budget is there, it’s the one. Otherwise compare it with the Steam Deck OLED. Model differences are in our Ally explainer.
